interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to configure. At least one interface is required.

id.description: Unique identifier (name) for this interface (e.g., eth0, enp3s0).

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the interface purpose.

match.description: Matching rules to identify this interface dynamically (e.g., MAC address, driver). Common keys: macaddress, driver, name.

set_name.description: Force a specific interface name (e.g., rename interface from enp3s0 to lan0).

dhcp4.description: Enable IPv4 DHCP on this interface.

dhcp6.description: Enable IPv6 DHCP on this interface (e.g., for SLAAC or DHCPv6).

dhcp4_overrides.description: Override DHCPv4-provided settings. Keys: use-dns, use-hostname, use-gateway, use-routes, hostname.

dhcp6_overrides.description: Override DHCPv6-provided settings. Same keys as dhcp4_overrides.

ipv4_addresses.description: List of static IPv4 CIDR addresses (e.g., ['192.168.1.10/24']). Required if DHCP is disabled.

ipv6_addresses.description: List of static IPv6 CIDR addresses (e.g., ['2001:db8::10/64']). Required if DHCP is disabled.

addresses.description: List of DNS server IP addresses.

accept_ra.description: Whether to accept router advertisements (for IPv6). If omitted, defaults to interface-type specific behavior.

routable_multicast.description: Allow routing to multicast destinations (for IPv6).
